name: usage-status
description: Shows the 5h and weekly Claude usage windows as progress bars, and their hourly rate, above the prompt

barColors.title: Bar colours
barColors.description: Stops as percent-used:colour, comma separated. A colour is a theme key (success, warning, error, claude, permission, suggestion...), a name (green, orange, violet...) or hex (#ff8800).

rateColors.title: Hourly rate colours
rateColors.description: Stops as percent-of-optimal-pace:colour, comma separated. 100 is the steady rate that uses exactly what is left by the window's reset.

blend.title: Blend between stops
blend.description: Mix the colours of two neighbouring stops instead of switching at each one. Works between names and hex colours, not theme keys.

barCells.title: Bar width
barCells.description: Number of cells in each progress bar (4 to 40).

rateMinMinutes.title: Rate delay
rateMinMinutes.description: Minutes of readings the session needs before the hourly rate shows.
